items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Alfred Newman was a monster. He ended up being a real close friend until he died

ctx.x: I started to get indoctrinated about what they were talking about, so I could understand a little bit. After a while, the Twentieth Century Fox movies, I could identify Alfred Newman’s influence on it. Alfred Newman was a monster. He ended up being a real close friend until he died, because he was not a snob at all. Then I could hear Victor Young at Paramount. They became like ideologies That was the bar – the standard. That was where the ceiling was. Stanley Wilson over at R.K.O. It was amazing. All of that…
